## Summary

Describe the user or engineering problem and the resulting behavior.

## Approach

Explain the implementation and important tradeoffs.

## Validation

- [ ] Automated tests added or updated
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Checked on iOS where applicable
- [ ] Checked on Android where applicable
- [ ] Accessibility considered
- [ ] Notification reconciliation considered
- [ ] Persistence and migrations considered

## Documentation

- [ ] Product or scheduling documentation updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Decision log updated if a lasting choice was introduced
- [ ] Roadmap or project status updated if milestone progress changed

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No credentials or sensitive user content are included
- [ ] Logs avoid raw audio, transcripts, titles, and notes
- [ ] Remote processing changes are disclosed and documented

## Follow-up work

List known limitations, deferred cases, or future tasks.
